استخفيت (form X)
# اِسْتَخْفَيْتُ (istaḵfaytu) /is.tax.faj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَخْفَى (istaḵfā)
# اِسْتَخْفَيْتَ (istaḵfayta) /is.tax.faj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَخْفَى (istaḵfā)
# اِسْتَخْفَيْتِ (istaḵfayti) /is.tax.faj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَخْفَى (istaḵfā)
